scope: Publisher-declared trust, evidence, provenance, correction and reuse surfaces for Brali. These are not independent endorsements.

surfaces.purpose: Source selection and evidence handling policy.
Ledger for material corrections to canonical published guidance or data.
Machine-readable AI/search discoverability, citation, measurement and guardrail profile.

measurement.reason: Brali exposes source metrics and benchmark outputs directly instead of collapsing them into a synthetic readiness, authority or AI-visibility score.

boundaries: Reviewed and practical are Brali publication states, not universal levels of scientific certainty.
Research candidates are discovery metadata and are not evidence by themselves.
Publisher-declared trust surfaces are kept separate from independent external trust signals.
Search or AI visibility is not inferred from the presence of llms.txt, JSON APIs, MCP or other machine-readable interfaces.
